title: Human health and exposure to microplastics and nanoplastics: a cross-sectional survey on public risk perception in Italian adults
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5VA00376H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Maria Scatigna, Massimo Aloisi, Anna Maria Giuseppina Poma
Public risk perception of MPs/NPs is associated with socio-demographics and information sources. The intention to change behaviour reflects the perceived threat perception but the actual knowledge isn’t accurate.
